children: Air T expanded and extended its financing with Alerus, raising the revolving credit commitment to $25 million and moving the termination date to August 27, 2029. Amendment No. 7 updates the borrowing base, adds a 0.25% unused fee, caps maximum leverage at 3.0x, and introduces a 120-day accordion option of up to $3.5 million each fiscal year. Borrowings accrue interest at one-month term SOFR plus a leverage-based margin of 2.25%–2.75%, with a 5.00% floor. In parallel, the company executed a $25.0 million amended and restated revolver note, a $11.46 million consolidated term note maturing in 2031, reaffirmed its guaranty and pledge, and put in place a federal assignment of claims on specified U.S. Air Force receivables.
